question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: they

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given **pronouns**. 

 
 
• "She" is a **singular pronoun**. It is a word that takes the place of a singular noun when the person is of **feminine gender**.
 
• "We" is the **first person plural pronoun**. **We **is used as the subject of a verb and before a noun to make it clear which **group of people** you are referring to.
 
• "He" is a singular pronoun. It is a word that takes the place of a singular noun when the person is of masculine gender.
 
• "They" is used to **indicate a nonbinary or gender-neutral subject **(doer) of a verb (action) instead of he or she.
 
 
 
• In the question 'they' refers to the** Frontline workers**.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 4.
